author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven

STATUSES.why_not_a_bare_COMPLETE: a bare COMPLETE on the Hospital collection would read as successful navigation. The compatibility purpose is complete; the navigation task was not achieved, and the two are recorded as separate facts.

PRIMARY_RESULT: A newly collected Hospital simulator trajectory was written in the published loader-facing trajectory format and successfully consumed by the pinned GNM, ViNT and NoMaD data paths.
LIMITATION_STATED_WITH_THE_RESULT: This proves framework/data compatibility, not successful navigation or dataset quality. The collected episode reached the maximum step budget and stopped 1.679 m from the sealed goal, outside the 0.20 m goal tolerance. One trajectory is sufficient for an execution/compatibility proof but is not sufficient for training, validation and held-out evaluation.

compatibility_table.note: sample counts are NOT expected to match; the frameworks' temporal and action specifications differ

NAVIGATION_TASK_COMPLETION_DETAIL.why_the_trajectory_was_still_admitted: reached_goal is not among the frozen post-episode compatibility conditions, which are the six adequacy thresholds plus data integrity. The trajectory is admitted because it meets what was frozen, not because goal-reaching was checked and passed.
